questions.question: What product, service, or offering is this one-pager promoting?
questions.hint: Provide the product/service name and a brief description.

questions.question: What are the key benefits or selling points?
questions.hint: List the most important features, benefits, or differentiators to highlight.

questions.question: Who is the target audience?
questions.hint: Examples: Consumers, retailers, distributors, investors, enterprise buyers, healthcare professionals, etc.

questions.question: Is there a specific offer, promotion, membership, or pricing information to include?
What are the offer details?
questions.hint: Offer, dates, what's included, pricing, and any conditions. Only if you said yes above.

questions.question: What copy/text should appear on this one-pager?
questions.hint: Please provide final content. Late copy changes may require additional revisions.

questions.question: Do you have photography, product images, screenshots, or other visuals?
questions.hint: Print assets should be a minimum of 300 DPI at final print size.

questions.question: Upload print-ready images.
questions.hint: Only if you have photography, product images, screenshots, or other visuals.

questions.question: What action should readers take after viewing this one-pager?
What is the destination URL for the QR code?
questions.hint: Only if you selected Scan QR Code above.

questions.question: Any reference designs or inspiration?
questions.hint: Competitors, favourite brands, previous sell sheets, or examples you admire.

questions.question: Upload reference designs, up to 3.
questions.hint: Only if you said yes to reference designs above.

questions.question: Describe the visual style you'd like.
questions.hint: Examples: Premium, corporate, modern, bold, minimal, technical, luxury, retail-focused.

questions.question: What size should the one-pager be?
Single-sided or double-sided?
questions.hint: A sell sheet is often double-sided, so this is worth asking.

questions.question: Any technical or print-specific requirements?
questions.hint: Leave blank if unsure — we'll use standard print specifications.
